title: Untitled (Target and Discs)
description: Mixed-media collage on a large white panel incorporates a printed shooting target, a vertical red strip bearing stacked compact discs, a silver foil rectangle, a gold heart-shaped element, and a red-and-yellow triangular road sign at upper left. Tape, wire, and small found objects connect the dispersed components across the pale surface.
composition: scattered elements across large white panel
